messages.content: Write a Rust function `fn min_item<T: PartialOrd + Copy>(items: &[T]) -> Option<T>` returning the smallest element, or None if empty. The bound is PartialOrd, not Ord.
Write a Rust function `fn sort_desc_floats(v: &[f64]) -> Vec<f64>` returning the values sorted largest-first.
Write a Rust function `fn decrement_to_zero(n: u32) -> Vec<u32>` returning n, n-1, ... , 0 as a vector by repeatedly decrementing a local counter.
Write a Rust function `fn count_char(s: &str, target: char) -> usize` counting how many times `target` appears in `s`.
Write a Rust function `fn second_smallest(v: &[i32]) -> Option<i32>` returning the second-smallest distinct value, or None if fewer than two distinct values exist.
Write a Rust function `fn char_frequencies(s: &str) -> std::collections::HashMap<char, usize>` mapping each character to its count.
Write a Rust function `fn mode_of(v: &[i32]) -> Option<i32>` returning the most frequent value (any one on a tie), or None if empty.
Write a Rust function `fn capitalize_first(s: &str) -> String` uppercasing only the first character and leaving the rest unchanged.
Write a Rust function `fn longest_word(s: &str) -> Option<String>` returning the longest whitespace-separated word (the first on a tie), or None if there are no words.
Write a Rust function `fn is_sorted_asc(v: &[i32]) -> bool` returning true if the slice is non-decreasing.
Write a Rust function `fn nth_largest(v: &[i32], n: usize) -> Option<i32>` returning the n-th largest (1-indexed) distinct value, or None if it doesn't exist.
Write a Rust function `fn running_sum(v: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>` returning the prefix sums.
Write a Rust function `fn to_hex(n: u32) -> String` returning the lowercase hexadecimal representation ("0" for zero).
Write a Rust function `fn group_consecutive(v: &[i32]) -> Vec<Vec<i32>>` splitting the slice into runs of equal adjacent values.
Write a Rust function `fn average(v: &[i32]) -> Option<f64>` returning the mean as f64, or None if empty.
Write a Rust function `fn swap_case(s: &str) -> String` flipping the case of every ASCII letter.
Write a Rust function `fn unique_in_order(v: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>` removing consecutive duplicates while preserving order (non-consecutive duplicates are kept).
Write a Rust function `fn digit_sum(mut n: u64) -> u64` summing the decimal digits of n.
Write a Rust function `fn pair_sums(v: &[i32]) -> Vec<i32>` returning the sum of each adjacent pair (length one less than the input, empty for inputs under 2).
Write a Rust function `fn clamp_to(v: &[i32], lo: i32, hi: i32) -> Vec<i32>` clamping each element into [lo, hi].
Write a Rust function `fn max_pair<T: PartialOrd + Copy>(a: T, b: T) -> T` returning the larger of two values. The bound is PartialOrd, not Ord.
Write a Rust function `fn top_k(v: &[i32], k: usize) -> Vec<i32>` returning the k largest values in descending order (fewer if the slice is shorter).
Write a Rust function `fn first_non_repeating(s: &str) -> Option<char>` returning the first character that appears exactly once.
Write a Rust function `fn range_of(v: &[f64]) -> Option<f64>` returning max minus min, or None if empty.
